title: MapleStory M Scrolls Guide
author: MapleStory M GM
summary: Official instructions for applying equipment scrolls and seals through Forge, including registration order, effect preview, supported scroll categories, equipment restrictions, and probabilistic-result warnings.

sections.title: Supported scroll purposes
items: Forge supports scrolls for Star Force, basic options, potential, emblem potential, equipment options, Exaltation, and Mastercraft.
The applicable effect depends on both the scroll type and the registered equipment.
Some scrolls determine their result probabilistically.

sections.title: How to open Scrolls
items: Open a scroll or stamp from Inventory and select Forge.
Alternatively, open Main Menu > Forge > Scrolls.
The interface accepts either equipment-first or scroll-first registration.

sections.title: Application process
items: Register the target equipment or the scroll that will be used.
Select a compatible scroll or compatible equipment from the filtered list.
Review the displayed effect, then press Apply.

sections.title: Restrictions and confirmation
items: Equipment conditions can prevent a scroll from being used.
Check the displayed applied effect before consuming the scroll.
Treat a chance-based scroll as a probability, not a guaranteed upgrade.

notes: Structured summary verified from Nexon's official MapleStory M forum guide on 2026-07-27.
steps: Register either the equipment or the scroll.
Select the matching scroll or equipment from the compatible list.
Review the effect and any probability or equipment restriction.
Press Apply to consume the scroll.
recommended_items: A compatible equipment scroll or seal
